sn51.22:1.2: atha kho āyasmā ānando yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami. upasaṅkamitvā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi. ekamantaṃ nisinno kho āyasmā ānando bhagavantaṃ etadavoca:
sn51.22:1.3: “abhijānāti nu kho bhante, bhagavā iddhiyā manomayena kāyena brahmalokaṃ upasaṅkamitā”ti.
sn51.22:1.4: abhijānāmi khvāhaṃ ānanda iddhiyā manomayena kāyena brahmalokaṃ upasaṅkamitāti.
sn51.22:1.5: abhijānāti kho pana bhante, bhagavā iminā cātummahābhūtikena kāyena iddhiyā brahmalokaṃ upasaṅkamitāti.
sn51.22:1.6: abhijānāmi khvāhaṃ ānanda, iminā cātummahābhūtikena kāyena iddhiyā brahmalokaṃ upasaṅkamitāti.
sn51.22:2.1: opātiha bhante, bhagavā iddhiyā manomayena kāyena brahmalokaṃ upasaṅkamituṃ. samañño kho bhante, bhagavā iminā cātummahābhūtikena kāyena iddhiyā brahmalokaṃ upasaṅkamiti. tayidaṃ bhante, bhagavato acchariyaṃ ceva abbhutaṃ cāti.
sn51.22:2.2: acchariyā ceva ānanda, tathāgatā, acchariyadhammasamannāgatā ca, abbhutā ceva ānanda, tathāgatā, abbhutadhammasamannāgatā ca.
sn51.22:3.1: yasmiṃ ānanda, samaye tathāgato kāyampi citte samādahati cittampi ca kāye samādahati sukhasaññañca lahusaññañca kāye okkamitvā viharati.
sn51.22:3.2: tasmiṃ ānanda, samaye tathāgatassa kāyo lahutaro ceva hoti mudutaro ca kammaniyataro ca pabhassarataro ca.
sn51.22:4.1: seyyathāpi ānanda, ayoguḷo divasasantatto lahutaro ceva hoti mudutaro ca kammaniyataro ca pabhassarataro ca.
sn51.22:4.2: evameva kho ānanda, yasmiṃ samaye tathāgato kāyampi citte samādahati, cittampi kāye samādahati. sukhasaññañca lahusaññañca kāye okkamitvā viharati,
sn51.22:4.3: tasmiṃ samaye ānanda, tathāgatassa kāyo lahutaro ceva hoti mudutaro ca kammaniyataro ca pabhassarataro ca.
sn51.22:5.1: yasmiṃ ānanda, samaye tathāgato kāyampi citte samādahati, cittampi kāye samādahati, sukhasaññañca lahusaññañca kāye okkamitvā viharati.
sn51.22:5.2: tasmiṃ ānanda, samaye tathāgatassa kāyo appakasireneva puthuviyā vehāsaṃ abbhuggacchati.
sn51.22:5.3: so anekavihitaṃ iddhividhaṃ paccanubhoti: “ekopi hutvā bahudhā hoti …pe… yāva brahmalokāpi kāyena vasaṃ vatteti.
sn51.22:6.1: seyyathāpi ānanda, tūlapicu vā kappāsapicu vā lahuko vātūpādāno appakasireneva puthuviyā vehāsaṃ abbhuggacchati.
sn51.22:6.2: evameva kho ānanda, yasmiṃ samaye tathāgato kāyampi citte samādahati, cittampi kāye samādahati, sukhasaññañca lahusaññañca kāye okkamitvā viharati.
sn51.22:6.3: tasmiṃ ānanda, samaye tathāgatassa kāyo appakasireneva puthuviyā vehāsaṃ abbhuggacchati.
sn51.22:6.4: so anekavihitaṃ iddhividhaṃ paccanubhoti: ekopi hutvā bahudhā hoti …pe… yāva brahmalokāpi kāyena vasaṃ vattetīti.
